obligations.statement: first_match owns the supplied async generator and closes it before returning or raising on match, exhaustion, predicate failure, or cancellation. Cleanup may suspend. Preserve the selected row, absence result, original error, and cancellation.
required_concepts: first_match owns the supplied async generator and closes it before returning or raising on match, exhaustion, predicate failure, or cancellation
Preserve the selected row, absence result, original error, and cancellation.
obligations.event_relation: Consumer exit on match/exhaustion/predicate exception/cancellation must await owned producer cleanup acknowledgment before caller completion.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Caller returns or raises while resource is open or close acknowledgment is outstanding.

dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover ownership of the supplied record source, cleanup acknowledgment before terminal completion on match, exhaustion, predicate failure or cancellation, and preservation of the selected row, absence result, original error and cancellation.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Ground each claim in the candidate-visible README, host API documentation and record-scanning implementation listed in the obligation evidence paths, using the port's actual source and completion interfaces.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict a resource remaining open or cleanup acknowledgment still pending at caller completion, or a change to the selected row, absence result, original error or cancellation.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: Accept semantically equivalent cleanup strategies; do not require a specific language syntax, library or cleanup implementation pattern without candidate-visible evidence.
